added.summary: Document @media takes prefers-color-scheme, prefers-contrast, prefers-reduced-transparency and resolution (from the theme and viewport) and answers forced-colors, color-gamut, dynamic-range, display-mode, update, scripting and color for the play surface. @container takes style() and scroll-state() queries, container-type takes scroll-state and anchored, and the cqw, cqh, cqi, cqb, cqmin and cqmax units size against the nearest container.
